title: Kompetenzbrille Study Program
description: Schema for study-program data files (data/programs/*.yaml). A program lists module categories, modules with credits/topics, and editorial mappings of modules to competencies of one or more frameworks. The same schema applies to JSON-LD serializations (see program-context.jsonld).

@context.description: Optional JSON-LD @context. When present, the document is simultaneously valid JSON-LD (see data/schemas/program-context.jsonld).

@id.description: Optional JSON-LD node identifier (IRI) of the study program.

id.description: Stable identifier of the study program. Format: <institution abbreviation>-<location>-<degree abbreviation>-<short name>, e.g. hu-berlin-ba-biw. Must match the file name (data/programs/<id>.yaml).

institutionAbbr.description: Short abbreviation of the institution (e.g. HU, HTWK, FHGR), shown in the program selector.

institutionUrl.description: URL of the institution's website, linked from the UI.

source.description: Source document (SPO / Prüfungsordnung), as a path relative to the app root or an absolute URL.

sourceLabel.description: Human-readable label for the source document (e.g. official citation of the SPO).

languageTag.description: BCP 47 language tag; 'de' for German-only programs.

competencyCode.description: Competency code of the referenced framework (e.g. "1.1") — quote it in YAML so it stays a string, not a float.

anyOf.description: Single-language rationale; shown for both UI languages.
Bilingual rationale, keyed by BCP 47 language tag ('de' required for German programs).
IRI form, as emitted by scripts/yaml-to-jsonld.js.

ref.description: Node reference: literal id (YAML form) or IRI (JSON-LD form).

anyOf.description: IRI form, as emitted by scripts/yaml-to-jsonld.js.

codeRef.description: Competency reference: literal code (YAML form) or IRI (JSON-LD form).

mapping.description: Editorial mapping of the enclosing module to a competency of a framework, or to the framework's Orientierungswissen (phase 0) via the reserved target __orientation.

framework.description: Must identify a framework in data/frameworks/ (literal id or IRI).

competency.description: Must match a competency code declared by the referenced framework file, or be the reserved target __orientation when that framework declares a phase 0 (literal code or IRI).

note.description: Rationale for the mapping: which topics/goals justify it.

module.description: A study module as defined in the SPO. Note: the module list is a complete catalogue including elective alternatives, so summing credits does not necessarily yield the degree total.

category.description: Must match one of the top-level categories[].id values (literal id or IRI).

$comment2: Cross-file constraints not expressible in JSON Schema alone: each modules[].category must equal some categories[].id; each mappings[].framework must identify a framework present in data/frameworks/; each mappings[].competency must be a code declared by that framework, or the reserved target __orientation when that framework declares a phase 0; modules registered in data/manifest.yaml.

note.en: Search methods and strategies; reference and information services.
